name: Having Dreams And Goals
overview: Scripture teaches that having dreams and goals is closely tied to delighting in the Lord and committing our plans to Him, as He establishes our thoughts and grants the desires of our hearts (Psalms 37:4; Proverbs 16:3). While we are encouraged to rejoice and pursue our ambitions, Ecclesiastes reminds us that God ultimately holds us accountable for the ways we walk in our hearts (Ecclesiastes 11:9). God's intentions for us are good and purposeful, promising a hopeful future when we seek first His kingdom and righteousness (Jeremiah 29:11; Matthew 6:33). Above all, Jesus is the way to the Father, grounding our goals in a relationship with Him (John 14:6).
